en.summary: This commit appears to be a structural or synthesis-oriented rewrite of LoopConv address expressions, not a DUT behavior fix.
why_it_counts: It touches core LoopConv address-generation code in a DUT file, so it initially resembles a correctness change.
disqualifiers: The commit subject, Re-duplicate some multipliers, reads like an implementation or timing change rather than a bug fix.
The changed expressions are algebraically equivalent to the pre-existing derived products.
The renamed irows_ds_times_ocols_ds field already held the same irows-downsampled times icols-downsampled product before the rename.
evidence: LoopConvState already computed orows_times_ocols, krows_times_kcols_times_ochs, and krows_times_kcols_times_kchs to the same products later in the file.
The diff mainly inlines those products at use sites and renames one misleading derived-parameter identifier.
No control predicate, queueing rule, command encoding, or state transition changes in the patch.

zh.summary: 该提交看起来是在对 LoopConv 地址表达式做结构性或综合导向的改写，而不是修复 DUT 行为缺陷。
why_it_counts: 它修改了 DUT 文件中核心的 LoopConv 地址生成代码，因此乍看像是正确性修复。
disqualifiers: 提交标题 Re-duplicate some multipliers 更像实现或时序调整，而不是 bug 修复。
被替换的表达式与原先的派生乘积在代数上等价。
重命名的 irows_ds_times_ocols_ds 字段在重命名前就已经保存了相同的 irows-downsampled 与 icols-downsampled 乘积。
evidence: LoopConvState 在文件后部本来就把 orows_times_ocols、krows_times_kcols_times_ochs 和 krows_times_kcols_times_kchs 计算成了相同的乘积。
diff 的主要变化是在使用点内联这些乘积，并重命名一个容易误导的派生参数标识符。
补丁没有修改任何控制谓词、排队规则、命令编码或状态转移。
